nod_hello.speaker: Aiko
nod_hello.text: Oh! A traveller. We don't get many out here. I'm Aiko.

nod_nice.speaker: Aiko
nod_nice.text: Likewise! Mind the pond, the frogs bite.

nod_passing.speaker: Aiko
nod_passing.text: Everyone is, these days. Safe travels.

nod_again.speaker: Aiko
nod_again.text: Back again? The frogs are still biting.
